brief: @buildthis.bisks.net create a page that lets me login and post to my bluesky account, and encode messages cryptographically in text/images. The page should also show my moots who also posted encrypted messages on a dedicated Shadow Simcluster page
note: built shadow simcluster: sign in, encrypt a message (real AES-256-GCM), hide it in a post or invisibly in an image, post it. /shadow maps your moots and shows who else is transmitting, with an inline cracker.
